title: React Native Developer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled
**React Native Developer**
to lead and execute the development of high-performance, cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional product, design, and backend teams to build intuitive user interfaces, integrate native device capabilities, optimize app responsiveness, and maintain release pipelines across mobile app stores.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Architecture & Feature Delivery:**
  Architect, build, and maintain clean, scalable cross-platform applications using React Native and TypeScript.
* **UI/UX Implementation:**
  Translate Figma/Sketch UI/UX prototypes into fluid, accessible, and pixel-perfect mobile interfaces.
* **API & Service Integration:**
  Integrate RESTful, GraphQL, or WebSocket backend services and third-party SDKs (analytics, payment gateways, push notifications).
* **Platform Bridging & Native Modules:**
  Bridge native iOS (Swift/Objective-C) and Android (Kotlin/Java) APIs into React Native when required.
* **Performance Tuning:**
  Profile and optimize mobile performance, addressing memory leaks, smooth 60fps animations, layout thrashing, and bundle sizes.
* **CI/CD & Store Deployment:**
  Manage end-to-end publishing pipelines, signing, and compliance for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
* **Code Health & Testing:**
  Write unit and end-to-end tests using tools like Jest, React Native Testing Library, and Detox/Maestro to ensure high stability and low crash rates.



Core Qualifications & Requirements

* **Experience:**
  6+ years of professional mobile development experience, with at least 4+ years dedicated to React Native.
* **Language & Frameworks:**
  Deep proficiency in React Native, modern React (Hooks, Context), TypeScript, and ES6+ JavaScript.
* **State Management:**
  Hands-on experience with modern state architectures (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, TanStack Query, or Recoil).
* **Tooling & Ecosystem:**
  Working knowledge of Metro bundler, Expo / EAS, React Navigation, and debugging tools (Flipper, React DevTools).
* **Native Tooling:**
  Familiarity with Xcode, Android Studio, CocoaPods, and Gradle for native dependency configuration and debugging.
* **Offline & Persistence:**
  Experience handling offline caching and mobile persistence (MMKV, WatermelonDB, SQLite, or Realm).
* **Version Control:**
  Strong command of Git workflows and agile/scrum methodologies.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Relay Yard Automation, Relay Yard Automation
description:
**Description**
Amazon moves millions of packages daily through a global logistics network of Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers, and Delivery Stations. Every facility has a trailer yard — the physical space where line-haul vehicles arrive, get loaded or unloaded, and depart. Tracking what's happening in these yards in real time (which trailers are where, what state they're in, who's arriving and departing) is a hard problem that sits at the intersection of physical operations and software systems.
  
  
The Relay Yard Automation (RYA) team builds the software that manages these trailer yards across 6,000+ Amazon facilities on three continents. Our products handle 200K+ gate transactions
  
  
per day and facilitated the arrival and departure of 55M vehicles last year. We integrate computer vision, RFID, GPS, ultrasonic sensors, and IoT edge devices to automate what were historically manual, associate-staffed processes, from gate check-in/check-out to in-yard trailer movements. Our gate automation program has already eliminated millions of manual transactions, with a long-term goal of fully autonomous yard operations.
  
  
The tech stack is diverse by necessity: Android mobile apps for yard associates and drivers, React web applications for remote gate agents and yard operators, Java/TypeScript backend services on AWS, and hardware integrations running on edge compute devices deployed in the field. Systems are loosely coupled, event-driven, and must operate reliably in environments ranging from 1M+ sq ft North American fulfillment centers to small urban European delivery stations.
  
  
As an SDE on this team, you will design and build features and services that power yard automation across Amazon's logistics network. You will write high-quality code across the full stack, contribute to system design discussions, and deliver projects from technical design through production launch. The role involves working across backend services, web and mobile applications, and integrations with physical sensor systems at the edge. You will make thoughtful engineering trade-offs, participate in design and code reviews, and contribute to the team's operational excellence practices — supporting tier-1 systems where your work directly impacts driver experience and Amazon's ability to meet customer delivery promises.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement software for yard and gate automation products across tier-1 systems. Your code runs in production where defects directly impact driver experience and customer delivery promises.
* Lead large projects end-to-end: define the technical approach in ambiguous problem spaces, decompose work into parallel workstreams, and deliver cohesive launches.
* Own system architecture for your team's services. Proactively simplify code, resolve architecture deficiencies, and remove bottlenecks across Java backend services, TypeScript/React web apps, Android mobile apps, and IoT edge devices.
* Make short-term vs. long-term trade-off decisions and communicate them clearly to your team and stakeholders.
* Integrate with physical systems — RFID readers, computer vision cameras, ultrasonic sensors, GPS — running on edge compute in variable warehouse environments. Debug problems that span hardware and cloud software.
* Own operational excellence for services you build: monitoring, alarming, runbooks, incident response, and root-cause corrective actions.
* Influence technical direction beyond your team through design reviews with partner teams across Transportation Technology.
* Act as a force multiplier. Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design artifacts, and reusable frameworks. Mentor junior engineers toward their next level.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:

Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. title: Staff Engineer I, TSG Software Engineering
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll work as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build, and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale, browser-based or mobile applications, built with modern technology stacks and increasingly with AI-assisted and agent-assisted development, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

The Staff Engineer I is a senior individual contributor role that reports to the Engineering Manager. The role can independently handle a software module/function, which includes technical delivery, stakeholder management, and communication, and is accountable for the delivery outcomes of the wider team. The role is also responsible for aligning the technical delivery goals with product vision. The individual is also responsible for role modeling, and for coaching and mentoring of the team from a technical delivery standpoint.

  

**Technical Delivery (75%)**

* Provide module-level technical leadership on teams developing and updating enterprise-scale applications at Bain, and help drive the overall delivery outcomes of the team.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Take lead for the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the links between stories and desired outcomes and support the Engineering Manager and Product Owner with product strategy.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of business and domain. Support Product Owner and Engineering Manager in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown, and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule. Support junior team members in analyzing requirements and completion of technical tasks.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure.
* Help improve the infrastructure to optimize the application development.
* Contribute in the design, architecting, and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades, primarily working with Engineering Managers, Architects, and Project/Product Managers.
* Apply AI-assisted development tools and AI agents responsibly to improve team productivity and code quality, and set the standard for how the team uses them.
* Champion secure software development practices, including secure use of AI-generated code, review of AI output, and protection of data and prompts.
* Own both development and testing: create the end-to-end test plan, execute it, and ensure zero-defect delivery.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components and support/review other team members’ estimates. Actively make recommendations to the other team members for their task allocations to promote skill diversity and growth.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, review and support unit testing completed by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support, and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills, e.g. creating automation tests, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/load testing, etc., through internal/external trainings to be a T-shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Help ensure adherence to Bain development project process and standards within the agile team as well as actively participating in the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write and review technical documentation prepared by the team.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Actively promote the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies, especially in Gen AI, LLMs, and AI agents, beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team

  

**Communication (10%)**

* Clearly communicate and exchange ideas across multiple fronts, e.g., design, technical solutions.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during crucial conversations.
* Has strong listening skills to recognize needs of a team-member, and acts to deliver a great team experience.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.
* Provide feedback to Scrum Master, Engineering Manager, and Product Owner to improve team performance.
* Shares best practices across software group.

  

**Mentoring (5%)**

* Provide day to day technical guidance and mentoring to 1-3 less experienced engineers on the agile team.

  

**ABOUT YOU**

* 8–12 years in software engineering, including 2–3 years of technical leadership experience in owning complex modules, driving architecture decisions, and mentoring developers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Understanding of core architecture of the product and ability to suggest new technologies and approaches as per the product vision.
* Ability to deliver the assigned work independently with zero defects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills.
* Experience developing enterprise-scale applications.
* Demonstrated record of T-shaped behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/contingencies.
* Experience providing technical leadership to a group of developers.
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

  

**Software Engineering – Technical Skills**

* AI and Gen AI: understanding of large language models (capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns), Gen AI application development, prompt engineering, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vectors, vector databases, machine learning fundamentals
* Secure development: secure software development practices, including for AI-driven development
* Backend languages and frameworks: Python, .NET and .NET Core, Java, or equivalent; C#, T-SQL, etc.
* Web frameworks/libraries: Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* Architecture: scalable, secure, and maintainable system design; microservices, API design, and cloud-native patterns
* RDBMS: Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure services or equivalent
* Unit testing: xUnit, Jasmine, pytest, Jest, etc.
* Testing and quality: end-to-end test planning and execution, AI-enabled test automation, zero-defect delivery
* DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos DB, etc.
* Caching: Redis, Memcached

title: Staff Engineer - Salesforce/ nCino
description:
**About Us**
At OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower ambitious businesses and the communities they serve. Since 2015, we've lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while driving economic growth in the markets we serve.
  
  
**About The Role**
nCino on Salesforce is the platform our lending teams use to originate, approve and manage commercial loans in the UK and US. As Staff Engineer you will be the technical lead for the Salesforce / nCino engineering team in Gurugram. You will own the technical direction of the platform, lead the team's most complex work hands-on, and be the main engineering contact for Lending, Credit and CRM stakeholders.
  
  
What you'll work on
  
  

* Integration modernisation: Lead the move of nCino integrations with our core lending platform off MuleSoft onto direct, well-tested integrations, and retire the old flows safely.
* Platform upgrades: Plan and lead nCino release upgrades across the team, including impact analysis, regression testing and rollout.
* Production support: Own production stability for the lending platform. Lead incident response, root-cause analysis and fixes so loans keep booking without disruption.
* Regulatory change: Deliver regulatory changes in nCino, such as Basel 3.1 requirements, with the audit trail and change control a regulated bank needs.
* Integrations: Design and build integrations between nCino and our CRM, customer portal, customer due diligence (KYC) and credit bureau services, including via our data warehouse.
* Data privacy and access: Lead data privacy work such as record anonymisation, and standardise access rights and the security model across the org.
* Standard features first: Enable standard nCino features (for example product packages) instead of building custom code, and reduce existing customisation where possible.
* Test automation and delivery: Work with QA to grow automated test coverage and improve CI/CD for Salesforce deployments.
* Documentation and debt: Keep technical documentation current, and tidy up technical debt and deprecated components.

What you should know
  
  

* 12+ years of Salesforce engineering experience, including at least 3 years on nCino (Commercial Banking / Loan Origination) or a similar lending platform built on Salesforce
* Deep hands-on skills in Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Flows and Platform Events, and a clear view of when to use configuration and when to use code
* Strong knowledge of the nCino data model and features: relationships, loans, product packages, covenants, collateral and the loan lifecycle
* Integration design experience: REST/SOAP APIs, middleware such as MuleSoft, event-driven patterns, Named Credentials and OAuth, plus error handling and reconciliation between systems
* Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules and field-level security, and how to design these for least privilege
* Salesforce DX, source control (GitHub), automated testing and CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce (e.g. SFDX, Gearset or Copado)
* Experience planning and running managed-package upgrades with minimal disruption to users
* Experience working in a regulated environment, such as a bank or financial services firm, with change control, auditability and data protection (GDPR)
* Proven technical leadership: setting standards, reviewing code, mentoring engineers, breaking down and estimating work, and making sound trade-offs
* Clear communicator who can work directly with Lending, Credit and Product stakeholders across UK, US and India time zones

Nice to have
  
  

* Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer II, Application Architect, Integration Architect) and nCino certifications
* Understanding of commercial lending products and processes, including syndicated lending
* Experience with data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery) and moving data between Salesforce and other systems
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day engineering

Tech
  
  
We're pragmatic about our technology choices. These are some of the things we use at the moment:
  
  

* Salesforce Platform, nCino
* Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flows, Platform Events
* Salesforce DX, GitHub, CI/CD
* MuleSoft (being retired), REST APIs, Python and NodeJS services
* PostgreSQL, BigQuery
* AWS, GCP
* incident.io, Jira

Work Culture
  
  
We expect you to work in these ways, as well as encouraging and enabling these practices from others:
  
  

* Collaborate - We work in cross-functional, mission driven, autonomous squads that gel over time. We pair program to work better through shared experience and knowledge.
* Focus on outcomes over outputs - Solving a problem for users that translates to business results is our goal. Measurements focused on that goal help us to understand if we are succeeding.
* Practice continuous improvement - We optimize for feedback now, rather than presume what might be needed in the future and introduce complexity before it will be used. We share learnings in blame-free formats, so that we do not repeat things that have failed, but still have confidence to innovate.
* Seek to understand our users - We constantly seek understanding from data and conversations to better serve our users' needs.
* Test outside-in, test first - TDD keeps us confident in moving fast and deploying regularly. We write scenarios first, coupling tests to behavior rather than implementation.
* You build it, you run it - We embrace DevOps culture and end-to-end ownership of products and features. Every engineer has the opportunity to lead delivery of features from start to finish.
* Embrace difference - No egos - people listen to and learn from others at all levels, with strong opinions held loosely. A wide range of voices heard to the benefit of all.

**What We Offer**

* Health & Protection: Medical cover for you, your family & parents; life and accidental cover at a multiple of your salary
* Wellbeing: Annual health check-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and an Employee Assistance Programme — all sponsored
* Time Off: Earned, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity & paternity leave
* Life Milestones: A financial gesture of support at marriage, childbirth, and bereavement
* Flexible Benefits: Tax-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave & travel, and NPS
* Growth: Professional certification support, learning & development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days
* Our Workplace: Modern central offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee — we work hard to build a culture worth showing up for

title: Models Infrastructure Platform Enablement (Python + React), Multi-Asset  Strategies & Solutions (MASS), Analyst
description:
**About This Role**
**Introduction to Multi-Asset Strategies & Solutions (MASS)**
The Multi-Asset Strategies & Solutions (MASS) team is at the core of BlackRock’s portfolio construction, asset allocation, and active management ecosystem. MASS leverages BlackRock’s full spectrum of index, factor, and alpha-seeking capabilities to deliver precise investment outcomes and differentiated alpha insights. The team manages over $1 trillion in assets across commingled funds, separate accounts, model portfolios, and outsourcing solutions for wealth and institutional clients globally. MASS is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment where all employees are valued and empowered to succeed.
  
  
**Position Overview**
BlackRock’s Models Infrastructure team is at the heart of evolving the model’s platform and elevating the client experience through strong governance and cross-functional leadership on behalf of the investment teams in MASS. As the Models business continues to grow, we’re expanding to meet increasing demand and accelerate key initiatives.
  
  
As an Analyst, you will join a business team and contribute hands-on to technology enabled solutions that support the Models platform. You will work closely with partners across Investment, Infrastructure, and Technology teams to understand business use cases, requirements, and operating needs, translating them into robust, production ready solutions. Your work will focus on automating processes, improving data access and distribution, supporting releases and ongoing maintenance, and ensuring the stability and scalability of the models ecosystem within established governance and control frameworks.
  
  
This role provides exposure to client and product information and the Aladdin environment, with opportunities to influence platform scalability, automation, and engineering best practices as the business grows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Model Portfolio Platform
  
  

* Lead strategic initiatives involving technology delivery that strengthen and evolve the investment operating platform within MASS, driving innovation and scalability.
* Administer monitoring protocols to independently assess infrastructure resilience across platform domains.
* Represent MASS in cross-functional teams supporting platform enablement activities.
* Gather and analyze business requirements to improve processes and systems with a focus on usability for Strategists and Portfolio Managers.
* Triage and resolve production issues, manage partner concerns, and maintain clear runbooks for owned activities.

Business Analysis and Technical Design
  
  

* Develop and maintain strategic tools for Models Enablement.
* Develop and maintain scripts and tools supporting end-to-end models data workflows.
* Own and maintain model data gathering and distribution to stakeholders.
* Support and execute end-to-end UAT testing to ensure successful production operations across release cycles.

**Qualifications**

* Computer Science degree/B.E/B.Tech, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in asset management or financial services, with exposure to multiple asset classes.
* Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong interest in learning and leveraging Aladdin; prior experience is a plus.

**Skills & Technical Requirements**

* 1-3 years of relevant experience (Python + React)
* Strong hands-on development experience in Python, Streamlit, and Flask is required
* Strong hands-on experience with React and a solid understanding of API design; familiarity with Protocol Buffers is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of AI tools, AI-assisted development practices, and practical implementation of AI-enabled solutions is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with machine learning concepts, Python-based ML workflows, and AI-driven implementations is preferred.
* Demonstrated curiosity and a strong inclination toward learning and adopting new technologies.
* Project and program management skills—including planning, coordination across teams, and delivery execution—are strongly preferred

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Engineer 3 - Business Systems
description:
The CRM Technologies team builds, scales, and operates Salesforce-based solutions that power MongoDB’s customer lifecycle, from marketing engagement and lead management through sales execution, account management, renewals, reporting, and downstream operational workflows.
  
  
The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB’s top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes.
  
  
This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services.
  
  
You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
* Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities
* Administer and integrate marketing and enrichment platforms such as FCI, LeanData, Ortoo, and related GTM applications
* Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, data, and downstream business systems
* Support campaign management, campaign attribution, audience segmentation, campaign member management, and marketing performance workflows
* Develop scalable solutions for account management, territory planning, account assignment, ownership changes, and coverage models
* Design and support partner management capabilities, including partner onboarding, partner data management, partner lifecycle workflows, referral and lead registration processes, partner attribution, and partner communications
* Build and enhance partner portal experiences that provide secure access to leads, opportunities, campaign resources, enablement content, deal registration, performance insights, and relevant account information
* Enable activity management and Outreach workflows across marketing, business development, sales, and partner teams
* Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps
* Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation while applying sound judgment around security, privacy, and accuracy

**Responsibilities**
Technical Delivery
  
  

* Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms.

Marketing Technology Engineering
  
  

* Own and enhance capabilities across:

+ Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
+ Marketing enrichment and data normalization
+ Campaign and campaign member management
+ Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
+ Territory planning and account assignment
+ Activity and engagement management
+ Outreach and business development workflows
+ Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
+ Annual planning and operational planning processes

Integration and System Design
  
  

* Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms.

Data Quality and Governance
  
  

* Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data.

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns.

Platform Optimization
  
  

* Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
* Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation
* Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services
* Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks
* Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support
* Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions
* Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification required

Success Measures
  
  
In 3 Months
  
  
Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment.
  
  
In 6 Months
  
  
Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Establish yourself as a dependable technical contributor and trusted partner to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations.
  
  
In 12 Months
  
  
Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. Drive scalable improvements across lead conversion, enrichment, campaign operations, territory planning, outreach, data quality, and inbound and outbound integrations while influencing engineering standards and platform strategy.
  
  
**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Full-stack Engineer

title: Software Development Engineer III (Frontend)
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling checkout optimization, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik powers 15,000+ merchants globally, processes ~$2 billion in GMV, and continues to strengthen its AI-powered infrastructure across India, the UK, Europe, and the US.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
As a Senior Frontend Engineer on the Internal Admin Platform, you will own the console that GoKwik's operations, support and partner-management teams use every day to manage merchant accounts, applications, permissions and configuration. Our platform is multi-tenant: one system serves thousands of merchants, each with its own catalogue, orders, inventory, pricing and customers, and it handles millions of API calls every week. A developer ecosystem sits on top, where third parties build and publish apps that extend what merchants can do.
  
  
This is production engineering, not greenfield prototyping. The services you join already carry live traffic, real merchant data and third-party integrations that cannot break. The role owns architecture, not only screens: frontend conventions, performance budgets, role-based access across UI and API, and the backend endpoints the console depends on. Getting access control or merchant data scoping wrong is a security issue, not a UI bug.
  
  
The console is a React + TypeScript single-page app on Vite, built on a shared component library, with server state in TanStack Query and every form validated through Zod. An older shell still runs on a micro-frontend host with Redux and a different component library, and you will lead the move from one to the other. Where AI genuinely helps operators, such as search, summarisation or assisted triage, you will bring it into the console and design it so a human stays in control of its output.
  
  
What You'll Own
  
  

* Frontend Architecture - Own module boundaries, shared component and hook patterns, state ownership, and the conventions other engineers build on.
* Complex Admin Workflows - Build large data tables, server-side filtering, multi-step forms, bulk actions and audit-friendly detail views in React + TypeScript.
* Server State - Own server state end to end with TanStack Query: cache-key design, invalidation after writes, optimistic updates with rollback, and correct loading, empty, error and permission-denied states.
* Role-Based Access (RBAC) - Design and enforce access across UI and API, so permission rules are defined once, verified on the backend and tested in both places.
* Merchant Data Scoping - Ensure every screen, query and cache key is scoped to the right merchant, so one merchant's data never appears in another's view.
* Legacy Migration - Lead the incremental move from the legacy micro-frontend shell (Redux, older component library) to the modern Vite stack without breaking live users.
* Performance at Scale - Set and hold budgets for bundle size, code-splitting, virtualised rendering and measured interaction latency at real data volumes.
* Backend Endpoints - Design and build the Node.js + TypeScript endpoints your screens need, including validation, pagination, query shape and indexes.
* AI-Assisted Features - Build AI features where they help operators, with streaming UI, structured outputs, guardrails and clear failure states.
* Quality & Reviews - Write component, hook and end-to-end tests (Vitest/Jest, Testing Library, Playwright), review others' frontend changes substantively, and use AI coding tools while verifying what they generate.

Who You Are
  
  

* 4–6 years building production React applications in TypeScript, including ownership of a large or long-lived codebase.
* Deep React knowledge: rendering and reconciliation, memoisation trade-offs, concurrent features, and diagnosing re-renders with the profiler.
* Strong server-state design with TanStack Query or equivalent: cache keys, invalidation, optimistic updates and consistency after mutations.
* Hands-on with schema-driven forms (react-hook-form + Zod or equivalent) and a utility-CSS / headless-component stack (Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Radix or similar).
* Proven frontend performance work at scale: code-splitting, virtualisation, bundle analysis and interaction latency.
* Has implemented RBAC or permission-gated UI, and understands why the backend must remain the source of truth.
* Understands multi-tenant data discipline: every view, request and cache key must be scoped to the right merchant.
* Enough backend to own an endpoint: Node.js, REST design, validation, SQL and indexes.
* Uses AI coding tools daily and productively, with the judgement to catch generated code that is incorrect, insecure or untested.
* Testing discipline across unit, integration and end-to-end tests, focused on behaviour rather than implementation.
* Designs the empty, loading, error and permission-denied states, not only the happy path, and thinks about what a screen does when the API is slow or returns half the data.
* Improves older code incrementally, argues for rewrites with data, and raises the bar for others through reviews and conventions.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you work on large-scale commerce infrastructure where correctness under failure, performance at scale, and code the next engineer can change safely all matter. The Internal Admin Platform is the control centre for the teams that keep thousands of merchants running, so your work directly shapes how GoKwik operates every day.
  
  
You get high ownership of architecture and conventions, a modern stack, a meaningful migration to lead, and the chance to bring AI into an operator-facing product in a responsible way. We use AI across how we build while keeping full responsibility for what ships, in a collaborative, engineering-led environment with strong career growth potential.

title: Senior Salesforce Engineer
description:
The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in optimizing MongoDB sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. We are looking for a highly capable Senior Salesforce Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable CRM solutions that support MongoDB’s Sales organization. This role combines strong hands-on Salesforce development, solution design, cross-functional collaboration, and a modern engineering mindset to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions across the core Salesforce platform.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, test, document, and deploy high-quality Salesforce solutions aligned with business needs and engineering best practices

* Manage multiple priorities effectively while ensuring high-quality and timely delivery

* Build strong working relationships across teams and contribute positively to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in Salesforce development and enterprise application engineering
* Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, Flows, SOQL, APIs, and Salesforce platform customization
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, declarative automation, integration patterns, and scalable solution design
* Experience with CI/CD, deployment processes, code refactoring, and performance optimization in Salesforce environments
* Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems using APIs, ETL tools, and automation platforms

* Good understanding of AI-powered and agentic development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms, with the ability to use them effectively to improve productivity, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution delivery

Success Measures
  
  

* In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, and current implementations by working closely with senior engineers and stakeholders
* In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver one or more critical Salesforce initiatives and establish yourself as a trusted technical contributor within the Sales Apps team
* In 12 months, you will: Become a go-to engineer for key Salesforce solutions, build strong cross-functional partnerships, and contribute meaningfully to the scalability, quality, and long-term evolution of the CRM platform

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

title: IT Engineer,Software,Senior
description:
****Overview****
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
****Responsibilities****
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Platform Optimization & Org Health**

* Hunt down technical debt — dead automations, bloated triggers, redundant fields, and queries that scan half the database for one record.
* Audit and rationalize automations into a single, sane framework. No more “which of the five automations on this object actually fires first?” mysteries.
* Monitor org health proactively — governor limits, storage, API consumption, deployment stability — using Salesforce Optimizer, Event Monitoring, and custom dashboards you build yourself.

**Development & Code Quality**

* Build production-grade Apex — bulkified, governor-limit-aware, single-trigger-per-object, with proper separation of concerns (service/selector/domain layers).
* Develop Lightning Web Components that are reusable, accessible
* Hold the quality bar in code reviews — meaningful test assertions (not just coverage farming), no hardcoded IDs, clean error handling, sensible naming.
* Own and improve the CI/CD pipeline — scratch orgs, source-driven development, automated test gates, and deployments that don’t need a war room.

**Integration & Data Management**

* Design and maintain integrations via REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture — with proper retry logic, error handling, and idempotency.
* Champion data quality — deduplication strategies, validation rules that actually help, and migration practices that don’t create a cleanup project of their own.
* Troubleshoot sync failures and API limit issues across connected systems before they become someone’s escalation.

**Collaboration & Best Practices Enablement**

* Define and document development standards and best practices — then make sure the team actually follows them.
* Mentor junior developers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing — not lectures.
* Evaluate every Salesforce release (three per year) for features worth adopting and deprecations worth addressing.
* Help the team make smart clicks-vs-code decisions so the org stays maintainable as it grows.

****Qualifications****
**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Deep hands-on skills in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, LWC, and enough Visualforce knowledge to maintain legacy components.
* Strong JavaScript/ES6+, HTML, and CSS fundamentals.
* Expertise in Salesforce’s security architecture — profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, FLS, OWDs, role hierarchy.
* Solid Git workflow habits — branching, pull requests, merge conflict resolution.
* Proficiency with Salesforce CLI, scratch orgs, metadata API, and at least one CI/CD tool (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset).
* Sharp debugging instincts — Debug Logs, Query Plan tool, Limit monitoring, and the patience to trace a bug through five layers of automation.
* Familiarity with data migration/ETL tools — Data Loader, Dataloader.io, or equivalent.
* Comfortable in Agile/Scrum rhythms without needing a ceremony for every decision.

**Good to have AI Exposure**

* Understanding of AI/ML fundamentals — supervised vs unsupervised learning, model training, evaluation metrics, and data pipelines.
* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) — prompt engineering, fine-tuning concepts, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and API-based integrations.
* Familiarity with generative AI use cases in enterprise contexts — summarization, classification, content generation, conversational bots, and intelligent search.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools for code generation, test scaffolding, or automated code review.
* Basic comfort with Python or similar languages for scripting AI/ML workflows, data wrangling, or prototyping.
* Awareness of responsible AI principles — bias, explainability, data privacy, and governance considerations.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–9 years of hands-on Salesforce platform development — cloud-agnostic, problem-first.
* Active Salesforce certifications preferred — Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect, System Architect, or any specialist certification.
* Clear communicator who can explain a complex technical tradeoff to a business stakeholder without their eyes glazing over.

**Qualifications**

title: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Frontend Developer
description:
**About ETS**
ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.
  
  
Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are looking for a talented and passionate Frontend Developer to join our team and work on Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) projects. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining high-quality, responsive storefront experiences — across traditional SFRA templates and/or headless PWA Kit (React) storefronts — that
  
  
deliver engaging, personalized shopping journeys to our customers.
  
  
As a Frontend Developer, you will work closely with UX/UI designers, back-end/integration developers, and business stakeholders to translate designs and requirements into polished, accessible, and performant user interfaces. You will also follow best practices and standards to ensure code quality, performance, and scalability, in line with
  
  
current SFCC composable/headless commerce trends in the India market.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and implement responsive, high-performing storefront UI using SFRA, ISML, JavaScript (ES6+), and SCSS/CSS/Bootstrap, ensuring performance and reliability.
* Build and maintain headless/composable storefront features (PDP, PLP, Cart, Checkout) using PWA Kit and the Retail React App template, including Managed Runtime (MRT) deployments.
* Build reusable UI components and templates aligned with SFCC's front-end architecture and design system.
* Collaborate with UX/UI designers to translate wireframes, mockups, and prototypes into pixel-perfect, accessible interfaces.
* Integrate front-end components with back-end services using RESTful web services, OCAPI/SCAPI, and custom cartridges; handle data mapping between SFCC and the React frontend.
* Optimize front-end performance, including page load speed, Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, and caching strategies.
* Monitor and act on code-quality tooling (e.g., SonarQube) to maintain high quality-gate scores and resolve vulnerabilities.
* Ensure cross-browser, cross-device, and responsive compatibility across the storefront.
* Debug and troubleshoot UI issues using browser developer tools, SFCC Business Manager, and other tools.
* Perform code reviews, unit testing, and code deployment using Git/Bitbucket, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, and sfcc-ci automation.
* Collaborate with other developers, designers, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in front-end development, headless commerce, and Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
* Proficiency in SFCC front-end architecture, including SFRA and/or PWA Kit (React) templates and client side JavaScript
* Ability to implement customizations for complex business domains using ISML, JavaScript, HTML5/CSS3/SCSS, and Bootstrap
* Hands-on experience with React.js and headless/composable storefront development, including Managed Runtime (MRT), is highly preferred
* Familiar with responsive, mobile-first design and cross-browser compatibility best practices
* Familiar with web services and API integration using RESTful, OCAPI/SCAPI, and custom cartridges
* Working knowledge of Node.js and modern JS tooling/build pipelines
* Experience with code versioning and deployment tools such as Git/Bitbucket, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with code-quality tools such as SonarQube
* Strong knowledge of web standards, accessibility (WCAG), and performance/Core Web Vitals best practices
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills
* Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer certification is a plus

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
* 3 - 5 years of overall front-end/UI development experience, including at least 3–5 years hands-on with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFRA, ISML, JavaScript, SCSS/CSS) — required
* Hands-on experience with PWA Kit / React-based headless storefront implementations, and/or migration projects from SFRA to PWA Kit — preferred

**ETS is mission driven and action oriented**

* We are passionate about hiring innovative thinkers who believe in the promise of education and lifelong learning.
* We are energized by cultivating growth, innovation, and continuous transformation for the next generation of rising professionals as leaders. Â In support of this ETS offers multiple Business Resource Groups (BRG) for you to learn and advance your career growth!
* As a not-for-profit organization we will encourage you to lean in to your passion for volunteering. Â At ETS you may qualify for up to an additional 8 hours of PTO for volunteer work on causes that are important to you!
* The base salary range advertised represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. The base pay is only one aspect of the Total Rewards Package that will be offered to the successful candidate.

**ETS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe in creating a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity.**

title: Freelance Mobile App Reviewer and Finisher (Expo / React Native + Node/Postgres)
description:

send the below in mail to : info@valenmanagement.net

(1) 2-3 mobile apps you’ve shipped

(2) your experience with Expo and Postgres

(3) your availability and fixed-price quote

(4) one thing you’d check first when reviewing an existing app

We have a mobile app that is already built, using Expo/React Native, a Node.js backend, and a PostgreSQL database, hosted on Replit. We need an experienced developer to review it, test it thoroughly, and prepare it for launch.

Deliver a final report with a prioritised list (must fix, should fix, nice to have) and your launch recommendations.

Strong experience with React Native / Expo and a Node.js/TypeScript backend with PostgreSQL

A record of shipping apps to the App Store and Google Play

Comfort working with Replit projects and reviewing AI-generated code critically

Practical knowledge of authentication, email delivery, and API security

Clear written English and a habit of documenting your testing

Nice to have: experience with payment integrations and push notifications

Fixed bugs, or documented issues with reproduction steps

Backend and security review notes

Weekly check-in call plus written updates.

title: Product Engineer (App and Platforms)
description:
**Job Description**
This is a delivery-focused role rather than a purely supervisory one: you will carry out the majority of the day-to-day design, development, and implementation work directly. You will be Ansh's primary technical owner of our app and website, working closely with our Analytics Engineer to ensure data flows cleanly from the app into our dashboards, with the M& E and program teams to understand their requirements, and with the C-suite to ensure our technology and roadmap keep pace with our growth. Our tech team is small, so this role calls for a startup mentality and the initiative to step outside a predefined job description when something needs doing, rather than waiting to be asked. The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Develop and improve our field app: - Design and implement new features within our FlutterFlow app, from requirements gathering through to build and delivery, translating input from the M& E and operations teams into working functionality. - Maintain the app's underlying databases, including making manual data updates where required. - Own the full bug and issue-tracking cycle, identifying, prioritising, assigning, and resolving issues that affect app stability, data collection, or care delivery. - Manage version control and releases, testing and publishing new app versions, writing release notes, and notifying the team of changes. - Manage app accounts and access for team members, providing technical support where needed. - Periodically review and improve the app's design, evaluating user interface and user experience to improve usability. Maintain our website, tech systems and accounts: - Maintain and update Ansh's website (built in Wix), including content changes, functionality fixes, and periodic design/UX review. - Manage and maintain integrations with third-party tools (e. g., Trello, Slack, Google Workspace tools, Firebase), keeping systems efficient, up-to-date, and aligned with organisational needs. - Manage accounts and access for the tools and platforms our team relies on day-to-day (e. g. app accounts, website admin access, and other core tools), including onboarding and offboarding team members from a technical standpoint. - Conduct orientation on technology and tools for new team members. - Maintain basic security hygiene across the systems you own: access permissions, password practices, and account recovery. - Ensure backups for FlutterFlow, GitHub, and Firestore are conducted and monitored. - Support with ad-hoc technology projects and transitions, e. g. changing our Google Workspace. - Support with increased AI integration and technology innovation across the organisation. Follow good technical practice: - Apply sound engineering practices to keep our dashboards and app reliable and maintainable as they scale, rather than optimising only for short-term delivery. - Document your work clearly, so that systems and decisions are understood across the organisation rather than held only by you. - Recommend new tools or approaches that would help Ansh's team deliver more effectively. Work closely with the C-suite and program team: - Support the C-suite in building the product roadmap for our app and website, bringing a technical perspective on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. - Bring a technical perspective into strategic planning conversations, so Ansh's data and tooling keep pace with its growth ambitions. - Partner with M& E and program leads to prioritise what gets built next, based on what will most improve data quality, decision-making, or field operations. Requirements: - Around 3+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on work developing mobile or low-code app platforms (FlutterFlow, Flutter, or comparable front-end platforms). - Comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools (e. g. Claude Code) as part of a modern development workflow, with the discipline to keep the resulting code maintainable rather than simply expedient. - Comfortable managing accounts, access, and basic security practices across a small set of tools and platforms. - Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from non-technical colleagues into technical specifications, and to explain technical trade-offs back to them clearly. - High ownership and agency: comfortable being the primary technical owner of these systems in a rapidly growing organisation, and able to resolve blockers independently. - Adaptability: comfortable supporting new technology projects as they arise. - Fluent in English; based in India and comfortable working remotely with a distributed, mission-driven team. - Deep alignment with Ansh's mission, and a serious, evidence-based commitment to impact. Strongly preferred/nice to have: - Direct experience with FlutterFlow specifically. - Experience with website builders such as Wix, Webflow, or similar. - Experience integrating data from custom-built mobile or field applications into analytics tools. - Experience contributing to product prioritisation or roadmap discussions. - Familiarity with data privacy and security considerations for health data. - Fluency in Hindi. Company Summary Globally, 2.4 million children died in the first month of life in 2020 India alone accounted for 22% of these newborn deaths. The leading risk factor for mortality among children under five years of age is low birth weight, which is responsible for more than 80% of neonatal deaths. A simple solution holds the potential to significantly reduce these deaths: placing low birth weight infants directly onto the mother's chest for skin-to-skin contact, an intervention known as Kangaroo Care (KC). KC entails not only prolonged and continuous skin-to-skin contact but also exclusive breastfeeding and close monitoring of the infant. KC has proven to effectively reduce mortality and morbidity rates by around 33% (compared to the standard of care using electric incubators) by preventing hypothermia, fighting infections like sepsis, and helping the newborn gain weight through the caregiver's heat. However, adoption barriers for kangaroo care in LMICs, such as India, persist. These include insufficient equipment, a shortage of human resources, and a lack of privacy within healthcare facilities. Many of our target healthcare facilities even lack the infrastructure for conventional standard of care (i. e., electric incubators), further amplifying the potential impact of Kangaroo Care in low-resource settings. Our approach is both direct and cost-effective: repurpose existing hospital spaces to facilitate KC, provide essential equipment like infant weighing scales and cloth binders, and expand capacity by training and hiring health workers (HW) dedicated to teaching and monitoring KC for mothers in the wards. Why Join Us Ansh is committed to equal opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and strongly encourage applications from people who are underrepresented in this sector. We do not discriminate based on gender, age, disability, caste, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We are looking for someone genuinely interested in people and equally comfortable with the process. You will need to hold confidence, tell leadership things they may not want to hear, and keep the administrative backbone of the function running!
  
  
**Required Skills**
['Flutter', 'FlutterFlow']
