title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
  
  
With 2.4M+ daters, 1.47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world.
  
  
Link to our fundraising announcement
  
  
**Key Offerings Of Hunch**

* One Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.

**About The Role**
We're on the lookout for a SDE-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We’re looking for immediate joiners. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own backend features end-to-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async & event-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node + Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice-to-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design & delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End-to-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.

**Preferred Experience**

* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.
* LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.
* Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.
* Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive pay along with an annual performance-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).

**Life at Hunch**
Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room.
  
  
**What We Hire For - The ABCs**
Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
  
  

* Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.

**How We Work**

* Ownership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real - We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week - show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out - Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems - You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.

**Backed by Global Investors**
Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
  
  
**Experienced Leadership**
Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) - serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer-tech startup.

title: Technical Lead – Software Engineering
description:

architecture, and technical leadership capabilities.

mechanisms.

networking, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and production environments.

principles and design tools.

management, security, managed databases, serverless computing, container orchestration, monitoring, and

infrastructure architecture.

Actions, Azure DevOps, and automated deployment workflows.

• Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis, with

experience in database design, query optimization, replication, and data processing.

• Extensive understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, message

brokers, asynchronous processing, and third-party integrations.

• Proven experience designing scalable, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure software solutions, including load

balancing, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.

• Strong experience with production monitoring, centralized logging, observability, incident management, and

troubleshooting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, and Azure Monitor.

• Hands-on knowledge of software testing methodologies, automated testing frameworks, API testing, performance

testing, application security, and secure coding practices.

• Mandatory experience with IoT applications and platforms, including device connectivity, telemetry ingestion, IoT

cloud services, and communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, UDP, LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, etc.

skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**

Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

throughout the complete software development lifecycle.

Preferred Skills

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**Software Development Engineer – I (SDE-1)**

For Engineers Who Love Solving Hard Problems, Building Fast, and Owning Outcomes

**Experience:**
0–1 years

**Eligibility:**
Tier-1 colleges only

**Work experience preference:**
Engineers with experience at reputed product-based technology companies

**Role type:**
Individual Contributor

**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s most trusted Muslim Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. With
**65,000+ success storie**
s and
**over 2 Million+ members**
, we are committed to fostering strong connections and building a better community. Our AI-based algorithm ensures seamless profile searches and connections, transforming the way people approach marriage. Based in India, NikahForever has created a user-friendly platform where finding your life partner happens in just three steps: Register, Search, and Connect.

**About the Role**

We are looking for exceptional engineers who don't get intimidated by unfamiliar technologies, ambiguous problems, or tight deadlines.

We don't expect you to be an expert in every tech stack. We expect you to be the kind of engineer who can pick up a new stack, understand an unfamiliar codebase, break down a complex problem, and figure out a way to solve it.

You could be working on backend systems today, debugging a production issue tomorrow, building an AI-powered workflow the next day, or exploring a completely new technology to solve a business problem.

**We care more about how you think, how fast you learn, and what you can build than the number of technologies listed on your resume.**

This role is for people who want to become exceptionally good engineers by working on real problems, taking ownership, and shipping things that matter.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own problems end to end:**
  Take a problem from understanding requirements to designing, building, testing, deploying, and monitoring the solution.
* **Work across tech stacks:**
  Be comfortable moving between frontend, backend, databases, infrastructure, APIs, and AI tooling as the problem requires.
* **Build with AI at the core:**
  Use AI coding assistants, agentic coding workflows, and autonomous AI agents to accelerate development, debugging, testing, and problem-solving.
* **Think beyond the obvious:**
  Challenge assumptions, identify root causes, and find simple, scalable solutions instead of blindly following instructions.
* **Move fast and ship:**
  Turn ideas into working software quickly without compromising on correctness, reliability, or maintainability.
* **Take production ownership:**
  Investigate bugs, performance bottlenecks, unexpected failures, and real-world edge cases.
* **Explore and experiment:**
  Evaluate new frameworks, tools, models, and technologies based on whether they solve the problem better.
* **Operate with high ownership:**
  If something needs to be done, figure out how to get it done instead of waiting for someone to spell out every step.

**What We're Looking For**

* **B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program.**
* 0–1 years of professional software engineering experience.
* Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases, networking, and software engineering.
* The ability to learn unfamiliar technologies independently and become productive quickly.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. You should be able to reason through a problem rather than depend entirely on tutorials or existing solutions.
* A builder's mindset: you've built projects, experimented with technology, automated something, or gone beyond the standard academic curriculum.
* Genuine interest in AI-assisted software engineering and
  **agentic AI**
  — not just using AI to generate snippets, but exploring agents, tool calling, MCP, multi-step workflows, and autonomous task execution.
* Comfort working in an environment with high expectations, rapid execution, changing priorities, and significant individual responsibility.
* Clear communication, intellectual honesty, and the ability to ask the right questions when stuck.

**Prior experience at a reputed product-based technology company is a strong plus.**
We particularly value candidates who have already worked on real production systems, shipped features to actual users, or dealt with the complexities of maintaining software beyond a college project.

The Kind of Engineer Who Will Thrive Here

**You will probably enjoy this role if:**

* You see a new technology as something to figure out, not a reason to say a task is outside your expertise.
* You use AI to multiply your output, but understand the code you ship and take responsibility for its correctness.
* You would rather build a working prototype today and improve it through feedback than spend a week debating an implementation.
* You naturally investigate how things work under the hood.
* You take pride in solving a problem even when the solution isn't obvious.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity and don't need every task broken into tiny, predefined steps.
* You want to build things that real users depend on and see the measurable impact of your work.
* You are ambitious about your growth and willing to put in the extra effort when an important problem demands it.

**What This Role Is NOT**

* A role where you work exclusively within one programming language or framework.
* A role where your job ends at writing code and handing it off.
* A role where you wait for detailed instructions before taking the next step.
* A role where AI is treated as a novelty rather than a serious engineering productivity tool.
* A role suited to someone who prefers predictable tasks, narrowly defined responsibilities, and minimal technical exploration.

**How We Evaluate Candidates**

We care about engineering ability, learning speed, judgment, and execution.

Our evaluation may include:

* Data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving.
* Practical coding and debugging.
* Reasoning through unfamiliar systems or technologies.
* Building a small working solution with appropriate AI tools.
* Understanding how to verify AI-generated code, identify failure modes, and make sound engineering trade-offs.
* Ownership, communication, and the ability to explain technical decisions.

**Why Join?**

* Solve real engineering problems with meaningful product impact.
* Work across technologies rather than being boxed into a single stack.
* Build practical experience with AI-native and agentic engineering workflows.
* Take ownership early and learn by shipping.
* Work in an environment that values initiative, engineering judgment, and measurable outcomes.

**If you enjoy solving problems more than discussing why they are difficult, use AI to build faster, and want to become an engineer who can figure almost anything out — we'd like to hear from you.**

**Apply Now!**

description:
**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
**Who You Are**
As a Senior Software Development Engineer L4, you are part of the Data Platform Engineering team, helping customers make smart, well informed decisions by harnessing diverse, well curated healthcare data at scale. You design and build full stack solutions that support data driven products and platform capabilities across modern cloud environments. In this role, you contribute to responsive user experiences, scalable backend services, and distributed systems that support the performance, reliability, and security of Inovalon’s data platform.

* Design, develop, deploy, test, and support technical solutions using full stack development tools and technologies.
* Build user friendly, responsive web interfaces using modern web application frameworks and front end technologies.
* Develop backend services and application logic using Java, SQL, and Python, and build front end functionality using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Design and implement solutions using relational and NoSQL databases, with strong focus on scalable data access and performance.
* Deploy microservices using container orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, along with AWS managed services and related cloud tools.
* Troubleshoot complex distributed systems and resolve application and performance issues across the platform.
* Contribute to secure web application development by applying best practices in software design, implementation, and deployment.
* Support CI and CD pipelines and modern deployment techniques to improve software delivery and release reliability.
* Collaborate effectively with team members in a fast paced agile environment to deliver scalable platform solutions.
* Stay current with trends and technologies in backend and front end development and apply relevant improvements to engineering work.

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of experience in Enterprise Java development, and 3+ years of experience with JavaScript using modern UI frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js.
* Bachelor of Technology, Master of Technology, Bachelor of Engineering, Master of Sciences, or Master of Computer Applications, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Strong experience with Java, SQL, Python, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Expert level knowledge of RDBMS, SQL, and NoSQL database technologies.
* Demonstrated experience with caching, queuing, scheduling, concurrency, and event driven architectures.
* Demonstrated experience developing applications on or for Linux platforms.
* Proven track record implementing distributed systems, microservice architectures, and RESTful APIs.
* Strong experience with AWS preferred, and experience with Microsoft Azure, GCP, and/or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment techniques.
* Knowledge of best practices for implementing secure web applications.
* Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by staying current with emerging backend, front end, cloud, and platform technologies, and applying new learning to improve engineering outcomes.
* Demonstrate leadership by collaborating effectively with cross functional partners, contributing technical expertise in agile environments, and helping move complex platform work forward across the team.
* Demonstrate adaptability by responding effectively to evolving requirements, changing priorities, and the demands of fast paced platform development.
* Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying practical solutions to distributed systems challenges, performance issues, and full stack design problems.
* Demonstrate analytical skills by troubleshooting complex technical issues, evaluating system behavior, and using evidence to make sound engineering decisions.
* Nice to have: Experience in data pipelines; experience with big data technologies such as Snowflake and Datastax.

* Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;
* Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
* Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.

Work Environment
  
  

* This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

Mechademy is transforming the predictive analytics landscape for rotating machinery. Our flagship platform, Turbomechanica, seamlessly integrates applied physics with advanced machine learning to deliver prescriptive insights. Turbomechanica detects potential issues long before they become costly failures, enabling clients to maximize uptime, extend asset life, and reduce operational risks. By empowering clients with optimized performance and reliability of their multi-billion-dollar assets, we’re setting a new standard for operational excellence.

**What We’re Looking For**

People who would rather build than talk about building. You’ll fit right in if you:

* Like owning a problem end to end, from the first design note to production.
* Pick up new tools quickly, and have opinions about which ones we should use.
* Care about getting things right, because engineers make real decisions on what we build.
* Enjoy a small, energetic team that ships fast and celebrates its wins.

**Why Mechademy?**

Kickstart your career with a company that’s fun, innovative, and shaping the future of the oil and gas industry. Mechademy is where cutting-edge predictive analytics meets a culture of collaboration and creativity. We’re not your typical start-up company – we thrive on solving complex challenges with technology, fostering growth, and making an impact. Whether you're diving into groundbreaking projects, learning from industry leaders, or enjoying team outings, you’ll feel valued and inspired every step of the way.

•
**Work on groundbreaking technology**
that is shaping the future of rotating equipment diagnostics.

•
**Relish a challenging, dynamic role**
with opportunities for individual contributions that direct impact on the success of the company.

•
**Grow into a leadership position**
as Mechademy grows.

•
**Enjoy flexible work hours**
to work when you are most efficient.

•
**Generous compensation**
to help you achieve financial stability.

At Mechademy, your ideas matter, your growth is our priority, and your future starts now.

**About the Role**

An unplanned trip of a single critical machine can halt production at an entire facility. Turbomechanica exists to see that coming, and the team makes sure the right people see it, trust it and act on it in time. You do not need an industrial or mechanical background. Our domain engineers will teach you how turbines and compressors fail.

**Responsibilities**

* **Platform -**

* **Monitoring -**
  Build the workflows that turn detected issues into alerts, escalations and tracked actions, and the tooling that helps engineers prioritise, investigate and resolve issues faster. Work with large volumes of time series sensor data.
* **Reliability -**
  Add alerting, health checks and dashboards so we catch problems before a client does.
* **Engineering Quality -**
  Write clean, tested code and own features from design through production. Write design notes, take part in design and code reviews, and document what you build.
* **Ways of Working -**
  Ship in two-week sprints using Git, GitHub, CI/CD and ClickUp. Use modern developer tooling, including AI coding assistants, while staying accountable for every line you merge.

**Requirements**

**Must Have**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or a related branch
* 1.5+ years building and shipping production software
* Strong Python (preferred), or Java, Go, TypeScript or similar; solid DSA and OOP fundamentals
* REST APIs with Django, FastAPI, Flask, Express or similar
* SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL
* JavaScript or TypeScript, React preferred
* Web authentication basics (sessions, tokens, OAuth) and secure coding
* Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD
* Clear communication and a real willingness to learn and take feedback
* LLM APIs (Claude and other leading models), Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG and agent orchestration frameworks

**Good to Have**

* Open source work or side projects you can discuss in depth
* Interest or experience in applied machine learning or LLMs
* Multi-tenant SaaS systems
* Time series data or large datasets
* Mobile app development
* SSO / OIDC providers, role-based access control
* Docker, AWS or Azure in production; logging, monitoring and alerting tools
* Mentoring peers, writing clear design docs

**What This Role Offers**

* **Work that matters -**
  What you build runs in production every day at some of the world’s largest energy companies.
* **Hard, real problems -**
  Security, multi-tenancy, large-scale sensor data and systems engineers depend on.
* **Ownership -**
  A squad buddy gets you productive in 30 days; you own a part of the platform within 6 months.
* **Mentorship -**
  Learn from senior engineers and domain experts with decades of equipment experience.
* **Growth -**
  A clear path from SDE-1 to SDE-2.
* **Flexibility -**
  Flexible work hours and a hybrid setup.

**Selection Process**

1. Introductory call - A short conversation with our talent team about your background, interests and expectations.
2. Technical interview 1 - Problem solving and live coding, plus a deep dive into a project you have shipped.
3. Technical interview 2 - System design and full stack fundamentals: APIs, data modelling, scaling and trade-offs.
4. Hiring manager - A conversation with the P&M Squad Owner about how you work, own problems and grow.
5. HR and culture - Team fit, compensation and joining logistics.

*No trick puzzles. When you apply, tell us about something you have shipped. That matters more to us than where you have worked.*

description:
Senior Software Engineer, Product and Front-end
  
  
**About This Role**

* The Senior Software Engineer, Product and Front-end will help build Prudential Japan's next generation Product Engineering capabilities as part of the Japan Technology Transformation initiative.
* This role is responsible for designing, building, and operating digital products and platforms that support customer journeys, sales journeys, policy administration experiences, and business workflows across Prudential Japan's end-to-end journey of life insurance value streams.
* As part of a newly established Product Engineering organization, this role offers the opportunity not only to build products, but also to help establish engineering practices, standards, and ways of working that will shape the future of technology delivery at Prudential Japan. What you could work on We allocate after offer, across multiple domains. Customer servicing, portals used by our employees as well as customers to view policy information and execute certain business workflows. Sales Enablement, portal used by our sales team to manage leads and maintain regulatory records.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build customer-facing journeys, and the internal tools staff use when a customer cannot complete one alone.
* Model identity, consent and authority as first-class concepts, including the cases where one person acts on anotherʼs behalf.
* Work directly with the staff who handle these requests today, watching real cases rather than reading summarised tickets.
* Design for users of every age and confidence level, treating accessibility as a design constraint rather than an audit term.
* Instrument journeys so drop-off, error and abandonment are visible, then act on what they show.
* Share the APIs your journeys need together with their backend owners, rather than accepting whatever exists.
* Work closely with systems engineers, architects and business partners to ensure the quality and reliability of the product, and to deliver on business objectives.
* Work alongside long-lived legacy systems and decide, case by case, what to wrap, what to replace and what to leave alone.
* Engage with broader product considerations and planning across ideation, design, development, testing, business engagement and team leadership.
* Carry on-call for what you own, and run incident reviews that look for causes rather than for someone to blame.

**Qualifications**
**General**

* You do not need insurance experience. We will teach the domain.
* Five or more years in product engineering with genuine front-end depth, TypeScript and a modern framework.
* Demonstrated accessibility practice, with examples of what you changed and why.
* Experience in designing workflow and state and not only screens.
* User research or direct observation as a normal part of how you work.
* Advantageous: contact center or telephone integration, identity, consent or KYC workflows, and designing for older or less confident users.
* Degree in relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical**

* We run on AWS. We are not dogmatic about languages or frameworks and we do not screen on keyword matches: we care that you have gone deep in at least one stack and can pick up another. Depth in one column beats a shallow tick in all of them.
* AI assisted development: Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor. Knowing how to build Agent skills is an advantage.
* Frontend: TypeScript with React, and a framework such as Next.js. Strong CSS and layout skills
* Testing: component and end-to-end testing as a habit. Playwright, Vitest or Jest and accessibility checks in the pipeline.
* Design systems: consuming one, contributing to one, and knowing when to break it.
* Backend for frontend: API gateway with lambda or a small service, enough to own the layer your journeys depend on.
* AWS ecosystem
* Nice to have: analytics and session instrumentation (such as Amplitude), design tooling fluency (such as Figma), and telephony and contact centre integration such as Genesys telephony or Amazon Connect.

**Language**
English: Fluent to Native
  
  
Japanese: Working level. JLPT N2 or native is an advantage.
  
  
**Culture and Leadership Expectations**

* Act as One Prudential for customers by building integrated products across business domains Drive Change by modernizing legacy systems and improving engineering practices
* Be Highly Accountable for code quality, delivery, reliability, and production outcomes
* Engage with Candor through open collaboration and constructive technical discussion Demonstrate core values: Worthy of Trust, Customer Focused, Respect for Each Other, and Winning with Integrity

We strive to create an environment where each one of our people can bring their true selves and contribute to their personal growth and the firm’s growth. To enable this, we have zero tolerance for any discrimination and harassment based on the above considerations. "Role Summary Drive the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade agentic AI solutions built on a strong foundation of Java microservices, cloud-native architecture, and secure, scalable platforms. The role blends Agentic AI engineering with modern backend engineering practices to deliver production-ready, resilient, and governed AI systems, along with the ability to contribute to end-to-end application layers. Responsibilities THE MISSION Frontier models and autonomous agent frameworks have moved out of the lab and into the P&L. The binding constraint is no longer model capability — it is deployment. Most enterprise AI programmes stall in the gap between a pilot that impresses a steering committee and a system the business can actually run. The Frontier Deployment Consultant exists to close that gap. You will embed inside client environments — their tenancy, their data, their security review, their release process — and take a workflow from hypothesis to a production agentic system that keeps running after you leave the room. This is a builder-advisor role in the literal sense. You will hold the boardroom with structured business thinking and write the production code that makes the system real. Candidates who have only ever done one of the two will not be a fit. HOW THE ROLE OPERATES • Embedded, not adjacent. You work inside the client's environment on their infrastructure and release cadence. Expect 50–70% onsite presence, including travel across India, GCC hub cities and client HQ geographies where the engagement requires it. • Pod delivery. FDCs deploy in small pods — typically one Senior FDC plus two to three FDCs and engineers — with access to the practice asset library, PwC's Responsible AI framework and the GCC operating-model IP base. • Outcome-owned. Engagements are measured on time-to-value, reliability, adoption and realised ROI. Delivery milestones are an input, not the score. • Real enterprise conditions. You will work under client security clearance, on client-issued devices where mandated, and inside regulated, data-resident and occasionally air-gapped environments. WHAT YOU'LL DO 1. Diagnose and shape value Partner with CEOs, COOs, CDOs, CTOs and business unit heads to find the workflows where agentic execution changes unit economics rather than shaving minutes. Size the prize in terms a CFO will act on: cost-to-serve, cycle time, throughput per FTE, revenue leakage, total cost of ownership. 2. Build 0→1 at startup velocity Form the hypothesis, diagnose the workflow with structured consulting toolkits, and put a working, interactive prototype in front of the client in days. The proof is running software, not slideware. 3. Architect production agentic systems Design and implement multi-agent architectures across brownfield estates: planner-executor patterns, agent handoffs, durable state and checkpointing, retries and cancellation, human-in-the-loop escalation. Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) integration. Hybrid and graph-based retrieval over knowledge-graph and semantic-layer foundations. 4. Own the evaluation and run layer Build the evaluation harness before the system ships — golden datasets, regression suites, task-completion and toolcall accuracy, groundedness and safety scoring, LLM-as-judge where it is defensible. Instrument tracing end to end. Define and hold service-level objectives for accuracy, latency, cost per task and containment rate. 5. Engineer for the enterprise, not the demo CI/CD for non-deterministic systems, infrastructure as code, containerised deployment into client infrastructure, canary and rollback strategy, runbooks, incident response, and a documented handover that leaves the client's own team selfsufficient. 6. Make it safe and defensible Agent identity and credentialing, least-privilege tool scoping, secrets management, prompt-injection and OWASP LLM Top 10 defences, PII and DLP controls, data residency, full audit trail. Apply PwC's Responsible AI framework and map obligations to the DPDP Act 2023, sectoral regulation (RBI, IRDAI, HIPAA) and EU AI Act risk tiers where in scope. 7. Manage the room Translate non-deterministic behaviour, evaluation results, latency and cost trade-offs and governance constraints into commercially sound executive narratives. Own the working relationship with client CTO, CISO and CFO stakeholders. 8. Operate AI-native Set the benchmark for AI-accelerated delivery on the account — Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, agentic test generation, evaluations running in CI — and pull client engineering teams up to it. 9. Codify the IP Abstract deployment patterns into reusable assets: reference architectures, deployment blueprints, evaluation harness templates, governance artefacts, runbooks and role maps that travel across accounts and industries. WHAT YOU WILL BE HELD TO Accountability How it is measured Time-to-value First production workflow live within the mobilisation window agreed at engagement start Reliability Agreed SLOs on accuracy, groundedness, latency and uptime held after go-live, not just at demo Adoption Active usage against the target user base; workflow containment and fall-backto-human rate Unit economics Cost per task inside the agreed envelope; demonstrable TCO improvement against the baseline Self-sufficiency Client team operating and releasing the system without PwC in every change Asset contribution At least one reusable, documented asset contributed to the practice per engagement WHAT YOU'LL BRING — TECHNICAL Depth is assessed on demonstrated production work. Named tools are illustrative; equivalent experience counts. Core engineering — required • Python to production standard: typing, testing, packaging, profiling. Plus one of TypeScript/Node, Go or Java. • API and service design, microservices, async and event-driven patterns, Docker and Kubernetes. • Working depth in at least one hyperscaler — Azure, AWS or GCP — including networking, identity and cost controls. • Ability to architect hybrid pipelines that route across LLMs, SLMs and traditional ML components based on task fit, cost and reliability requirements Agentic build layer — required • Demonstrated depth in at least two of: LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, Pydantic AI. • Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and client implementation; agent-to-agent (A2A) interoperability patterns. • Multi-provider abstraction, model routing and fallback (LiteLLM or equivalent). • Long-running and durable execution (Temporal or equivalent), agent memory and state (Mem0, Zep or custom), checkpointing and replay. Retrieval and knowledge — required • Ingestion and chunking pipeline design, embedding lifecycle and re-indexing strategy, reranking, hybrid and graph retrieval, RAG evaluation. • Vector stores: Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector or Azure AI Search. • Knowledge graph and ontology work — Neo4j, GraphRAG, semantic layer design — is a strong differentiator. • Document AI and structured information extraction - extracting structured data from unstructured and semistructured sources (contracts, invoices, forms, scanned records, PDFs) using OCR, layout-aware models and document AI platforms (e.g., Azure Document Intelligence, AWS Textract, Google Document AI) Evaluation, observability and LLMOps — required, and assessed first • Evaluation harness design: golden datasets, regression suites, LLM-as-judge, adversarial and edge-case sets, statistical treatment of non-determinism. • Tracing, prompt and version management, drift and hallucination detection — LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave or equivalent. • Guardrail frameworks, red-teaming, and continuous evaluation running inside CI. • Traditional NLP, SLM fine-tuning, quantization and distillation to verify, ground or cross-validate LLM outputs Enterprise AI platforms — required • Production experience on at least one of: Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, Snowflake Cortex. • Working familiarity with agent capabilities embedded in enterprise suites — Salesforce Agentforce, ServiceNow AI Agents, Microsoft Copilot Studio, SAP Joule. Integration and data — required • Systems of record: SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday. Integration middleware: MuleSoft, Boomi or equivalent iPaaS. • Event streaming (Kafka), CDC and ELT patterns, data quality, lineage and contract testing. • Comfort with undocumented legacy APIs, mainframe-adjacent estates, and incumbent RPA estates (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism) that agents must displace or coexist with. Production operations — required • CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring and alerting, structured logging, incident management and on-call discipline. • Release strategy for non-deterministic systems: canary, shadow mode, staged autonomy, rollback. Security and Responsible AI — required • Identity and access for non-human actors: OAuth2/OIDC, service principals, workload identity, short-lived credentials, secrets management. • Least-privilege tool scoping, prompt-injection and data-exfiltration defence, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, PII and DLP handling, immutable audit trails. • Working knowledge of NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act risk tiering and India's DPDP Act 2023. Inference economics — required • Token cost modelling, prompt and context caching, model cascading and routing, batch versus real-time tradeoffs, small-model substitution and distillation. WHAT YOU'LL BRING — CONSULTING AND COMMERCIAL • Structured problem solving. Issue trees, hypothesis-driven diagnosis, MECE decomposition — used to narrow scope fast, not to decorate a deck. • Commercial instinct. You design to ROI, TCO, adoption and change effort rather than to novelty, and can construct and defend a business case. • Executive presence. You can debate integration detail with client engineers in the morning and lead a board-level transformation session in the afternoon. • Change and adoption design. Role redesign, human-in-the-loop operating models, controls and assurance — the work that determines whether the system is actually used. • High agency. Ambiguous problem statements, undocumented systems and unhelpful vendors are the normal operating condition, not an escalation. THE EVIDENCE BAR We assess demonstrated deployment, not CV pattern-matching. Shortlisted candidates should be able to evidence all of the following: • At least two LLM or agentic systems you personally built that reached production and were used by people outside your own team. Internal demos, vendor lab builds, hackathon projects and proofs of concept that never entered a production environment do not qualify. • Code you have written in the last twelve months. You will be asked to walk through it line by line. • An evaluation harness you designed — and a specific failure it caught before it reached users. • A production incident on an AI system you owned: what broke, what you changed, what it cost. • A business outcome you can quantify and defend under CFO-grade questioning. • Willingness to remain hands-on. FDCs spend at least half their time building; Senior FDCs at least 30%. TWO LEVELS, ONE ROLE Level Experience Time building Owns Frontier Deployment Consultant (Manager) 5–7 years 50–70% Workstream outcomes, system build, evaluation harness, client engineering relationship Senior Frontier Deployment Consultant (Associate Director) 7–10 years 30–40% Account-level outcomes, pod leadership, architecture and governance standards, CXO relationships, practice assets BACKGROUND WE LOOK FOR A degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent capability demonstrated through work. We deliberately do not filter on institution. Non-linear profiles are actively welcomed — technical founders, staff engineers who moved into client-facing work, consultants who learned to ship. An MBA is neither required nor an advantage on its own. Preferred, not required • Delivery experience inside a GCC or global business services environment. • Depth in one industry — BFSI, life sciences, energy, telecom or industrial products — and process fluency in S2P, O2C, R2R, claims, KYC/AML or clinical operations. • Deployment inside a regulated or data-resident environment. • Process mining or workflow discovery (Celonis or equivalent). • Open-source contribution, published technical writing or conference work in the agentic space. HOW WE SELECT • 1. Portfolio walkthrough (45 min). One production system you built, end to end, including what you got wrong. • 2. Live build (2–3 hours). A timeboxed agentic build against a messy, partially documented data source. AI coding assistants permitted and expected. • 3. Evaluation and failure design (60 min). You are handed a working agent, asked to design its evaluation harness, then asked to break it. • 4. Brownfield integration case (60 min). Architecture and trade-off reasoning against a legacy estate with real constraints. • 5. Executive simulation (45 min). Present outcome, risk and cost narrative to a mock CXO panel. • 6. Practice fit. Conversation with practice leadership on how you work and what you want to build. WHY JOIN PwC • Front-row impact. Shape the core AI strategies and operating fabric of leading global enterprises and Global Capability Centers, at the point where decisions actually get made. • Both halves of the job. The strategic reach, industry breadth and executive access of top-tier consulting, with the speed, autonomy and modern stack of a frontier AI team. • Leverage. What you build once becomes practice IP deployed across accounts and markets — your work compounds instead of ending at go-live. • Compounding learning. Senior practice partners, exceptional peers, and a direct hand in PwC's point of view on autonomous enterprise systems. title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon \- WeWork, Cybercity (in\-person, 6 days)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Founding team
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹15 LPA \+ meaningful equity (0\.5–2%)
 



  





**About Switch** 




 Businesses in India lose money every day someone doesn't show up. A restaurant short two waiters on a Friday night, a warehouse missing four loaders before a festive spike, a store with no one to run the counter \- the current fix is a WhatsApp group, an agency that takes a cut and disappears, or the owner working the floor themselves.
 



 Switch is building the layer that fixes this. Shops, restaurants, warehouses, offices, and event venues book Aadhaar\-verified staff \- helpers, guards, cooks, drivers, riders, housekeeping, event crew \- in three taps, often deployed the same day. No advance, replacement guaranteed, clean invoices. On the other side, we give workers real, repeat, dignified income instead of standing at a labour chowk hoping for a day's work.
 



 We're live in Gurgaon, running real shifts for real businesses. We're small, pre\-seed, and moving fast.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'd be our first engineer. Not the first engineer on a team \- the engineering team.
 



 Today a lot of Switch runs on human effort: matching, confirmations, replacements, and support all lean on the ops team and WhatsApp. That's the right way to start and the wrong way to scale. Your job is to turn what ops does by hand into software that does it in seconds, and to build the product surface \- worker app, business app, internal tools \- that lets us go from one city to many.
 



 You will write the code, choose the stack, ship it, and be on the hook when it breaks at 9pm on a Saturday during someone's dinner rush. In return you get real ownership of the technical direction and a front\-row seat to everything else: pricing, ops, hiring, fundraising.
 



  





**What you'll actually build (first 6 months)** 



* Matching engine. Turn a booking into the right worker — availability, location, skill, reliability history, price \- fast enough that "same day" becomes "same hour."
* Worker app. Shift discovery, one\-tap accept, check\-in/check\-out with geofencing, attendance proof, payouts and earnings history.
* Business app \+ web. Booking flow, live shift status, replacements, subscription management, GST\-clean invoicing.
* Ops console. The internal tool that lets one ops person run what currently takes three \- exception queues, no\-show detection and auto\-replacement, escalations.
* Payments and payouts. Collections, worker payouts, reconciliation, refunds \- via UPI and standard PGs.
* Trust infrastructure. Aadhaar/KYC verification flows, background\-check pipeline, ratings, fraud and proxy\-attendance detection.



  





**You're probably a fit if you** 



* Have 2\-6 years shipping production software, and can point at systems you built end\-to\-end \- schema through UI \- that real users depended on.
* Are genuinely full\-stack: comfortable in a backend language and framework of your choice, a modern frontend, a mobile framework (React Native / Flutter / native), SQL, and enough AWS/GCP to run it all without a DevOps hire.
* Have built for scrappy, real\-world conditions: flaky networks, ₹8,000 Android phones, users who won't read instructions, workflows that live in Hindi and WhatsApp.
* Ship fast and ruthlessly scope. You know which corners are safe to cut at pre\-seed and which ones will burn you.
* Will sit with an ops teammate for an afternoon, watch them do a job manually, and go build the thing that deletes it.
* Want to be in the room. This is an in\-person role \- the speed comes from the whiteboard, the desk next to you, and the field visits.



  





**Nice to have, not required** 



* Marketplace, gig\-economy, logistics, or on\-demand experience (Zomato/Swiggy/Urban Company/Rapido/Porter\-shaped problems).
* Payments, UPI, KYC, or fintech integration work.
* Blue\-collar or Bharat\-focused products; vernacular UX.
* You've been early at a startup before and know what year one really feels like.



 The honest part
 



 Pre\-seed means uncertainty. Some of what you build will be thrown away. You'll do things that aren't engineering \- sit in on sales calls, go to a client's warehouse at 7am, help onboard workers. There is no platform team, no on\-call rotation, no one to hand a bug to. Runway is finite and the equity is a bet, not a guarantee.
 



 If that reads as a warning, this isn't your role. If it reads as the interesting part, keep going.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Competitive cash for a pre\-seed startup, plus founding\-level equity.
* Full technical ownership \- stack, architecture, hiring the team under you.
* Direct work with the founders, no layers.
* Health insurance and a laptop of your choosing.
* A product where you can watch the impact the same week you ship it \- in shifts filled, and in what a worker took home.



  





**How to apply** 




 Email hr@switchlocally.com with the subject "Founding Engineer" and include:
 


1. Your GitHub, portfolio, or the most interesting thing you've shipped \- and what your specific contribution was.
2. A short answer: You have one week and no data science team. How would you decide which worker to send to a booking? A paragraph is plenty. We care about how you think, not the right answer.
3. Anything you've built that people outside your company actually used.



 We move fast: intro call, a paid take\-home or a day working with us on a real problem, founder conversation, offer. Typically under two weeks.

 Financial management, payments, and investment tracking happen on the go. * Manage backups and restoration procedures.

* Monitor performance and website health.
* Manage WordPress/PHP version upgrades.

* Identify slow plugins, queries, scripts, and third\-party dependencies.
* Optimize images and media delivery.
* Implement appropriate caching strategies.
* Optimize CSS and JavaScript loading.
* Work with SEO teams to maintain technical SEO performance.

**Security** 




  




* Maintain WordPress security best practices.
* Manage WordPress core, plugin, and theme updates.
* Identify vulnerable or obsolete plugins.
* Implement appropriate access controls.
* Support security reviews and vulnerability remediation.
* Work with IT/security teams on penetration testing and remediation.
* Ensure appropriate backup and recovery procedures.
* Follow organizational security and compliance requirements.



  





**Integrations** 




  




* Develop and maintain integrations between WordPress and external systems such as CRM, marketing automation, analytics, forms, lead\-generation platforms, social platforms, SEO platforms, third\-party SaaS applications, and internal applications.
* Use REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and authentication mechanisms.
* Troubleshoot API integration and data\-flow issues.



  





**SEO \& Analytics** 




  




* Work with SEO and Marketing teams to support SEO and analytics requirements.
* Support GA4, Google Search Console, structured data/schema, XML sitemaps, metadata, canonical URLs, redirects, robots.txt, technical SEO, website tracking, and conversion tracking.



  





**Release \& Change Management** 




  




* Manage website releases from development to staging to production.
* Establish appropriate deployment and rollback procedures.
* Conduct pre\-production testing.
* Maintain release documentation.
* Ensure production changes are controlled and traceable.
* Minimize production downtime and deployment risks.



  





**Technical Leadership** 




  




* Act as the technical point of contact for WordPress.

* Review work produced by other developers.
* Establish development standards and best practices.
* Perform code reviews.
* Mentor the 5\+ year WordPress developer.
* Identify technical debt and recommend remediation.
* Maintain technical documentation and architecture information.
* Help define the future WordPress/web technology roadmap.



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




  




* Work closely with Creative, UX/UI, Marketing, SEO, Content, Product/business stakeholders, Data/Analytics, IT, Cybersecurity, and external agencies/vendors.
* Translate between business requirements, creative designs, and technical implementation.



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Must Have** 




  




* 8\+ years of professional web development experience.
* 5\+ years of strong WordPress development experience.
* Strong PHP and WordPress architecture/development.
* HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, responsive web development.
* 
* WordPress themes and custom plugins.

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Graduate Technology Associate – Freshers
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 Dataseashore Technology is looking for recent technology graduates who are curious, hands\-on and serious about building a career in technology.
 



 This is not a hiring drive for one fixed technology stack.
 



 We are looking for strong early\-career talent first. Based on your aptitude, interests and demonstrated capability, you may work across:
 



  





 • AI \& Generative AI
 



 • Data \& Analytics
 



 • Data Engineering
 



 • Full Stack / MERN
 



 • Python \& Backend Development
 



 • Cloud \& DevOps
 



 • Automation \& Integrations
 



 • Software Engineering
 



  





 Your technology track can evolve based on your strengths, interests and the problems you are able to solve.
 



  





**WHAT YOU MAY WORK ON** 




  





 Depending on your strengths and assigned technology track, you may work on:
 



  





 • Generative AI and AI applications
 



 • LLMs, RAG and AI agents
 



 • Python development
 



 • Data analytics and data engineering
 



 • SQL and databases
 



 • React, Node.js and MERN applications
 



 • Backend APIs and integrations
 



 • Cloud applications
 



 • Workflow and business\-process automation
 



 • Internal technology products
 



 • Client\-facing technology solutions
 



 • Prototypes that may evolve into production applications
 



  





 You are not expected to know all of these technologies.
 



 We are more interested in your ability to learn, think, solve problems and build.
 



  





**WHO SHOULD APPLY** 




  





 Please apply if you:
 



 • Have completed B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA
 



 • Are a fresher or recent graduate
 



 • Want to build a serious career in technology
 



 • Have basic programming knowledge
 



 • Are comfortable learning new technologies
 



 • Enjoy solving problems
 



 • Can learn independently
 



 • Are willing to work across technologies rather than restricting yourself to one stack
 



 • Are available for full\-time employment
 



 • Are willing to work on\-site in Gurugram
 



 • Are comfortable working in a lean, fast\-moving technology company
 



  





**WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT** 




 We care more about what you have tried to build than how many certificates you have collected.
 



 It could be:
 



  





 • A college project
 



 • A website or web application
 



 • A MERN application
 



 • A Python application
 



 • An AI chatbot or AI agent
 



 • A Data or Analytics project
 



 • An API integration
 



 • An automation workflow
 



 • A dashboard
 



 • A cloud project
 



 • A GitHub repository
 



 • Any technology prototype you built yourself
 



  





 Your project does not need to be perfect.
 



  





 We want to understand:
 



  





 • What did you build?
 



 • What part did you personally work on?
 



 • What problems did you face?
 



 • How did you solve them?
 



 • What did you learn?
 



  





  





**WHAT WE LOOK FOR** 




  





 Learning Ability
 



 Can you understand something unfamiliar and start working with it?
 



  





 Problem Solving
 



 Can you break an unfamiliar problem into smaller pieces and work towards a solution?
 



  





 Curiosity
 



 Do you explore technology beyond your college curriculum?
 



  





 Ownership
 



 Can you take responsibility for completing something?
 



  





 Execution
 



 Do you actually build things rather than only completing courses and certifications?
 



  





 Communication
 



 Can you clearly explain what you have built and how it works?
 



  





  





 POSSIBLE TECHNOLOGY TRACKS
 



  





 Depending on your capability, interests and business requirements, you may begin or grow into:
 



  





 • AI / Generative AI
 



 • Data \& Analytics
 



 • Data Engineering
 



 • Full Stack / MERN
 



 • Python / Backend Engineering
 



 • Cloud \& DevOps
 



 • Automation \& Integrations
 



  





 You do not need to decide your entire technology career before joining.
 



  





 We want to identify people with strong fundamentals and learning ability and then align them with the technology track where they can perform best.
 



  





  





 SELECTION PROCESS
 



  





 Shortlisted candidates may be asked to:
 



  





 • Explain something they have built
 



 • Share a GitHub, portfolio or project link
 



 • Solve a basic programming or logical problem
 



 • Work through a real\-world technology use case
 



 • Explore an unfamiliar technology and explain their approach
 



 • Complete a short practical assignment
 



  





 We are not looking for candidates who have memorised hundreds of interview questions.
 



  





 We are looking for graduates who can:
 



  





 THINK. LEARN. BUILD. IMPROVE.
 



  





  





 IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY
 



  





 This opportunity is specifically intended for freshers and recent graduates starting their technology careers.
 



  





 Eligible qualifications:
 



  





 B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA
 



  





 When applying, please include your GitHub profile, portfolio, project link or a short description of something you have built wherever possible.
 



  





  





 ABOUT DATASEASHORE TECHNOLOGY
 



  




* Dataseashore Technology works across AI, Data, Cloud, Automation and Software Engineering, building practical technology solutions for real business problems.

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Senior Specialist
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The
 **Global Digital Marketing Automation Senior Specialist** 
 is a deep, day\-to\-day expert in Marketo (or an equivalent platform such as Eloqua, Pardot, or HubSpot) who owns and optimizes our marketing automation engine. You’ll manage everything from advanced campaign builds and third\-party integrations to lead lifecycle strategy, event operations, and data governance — acting as the platform’s subject matter expert across the organization.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for someone who has moved beyond basic email sends and wants to own the architecture, personalization, and performance of a marketing automation instance end\-to\-end.
   

  

**Platform Management \& Campaign Execution**
* Manage, build, and optimize advanced Marketo core assets daily, including Smart Campaigns, Programs, Smart Lists, and flow logic
* Build and maintain universal, advanced Marketo Forms with progressive profiling, UTM parameter capture, hidden fields, and custom JavaScript for use across multiple workspaces
* Design and deploy standard landing page templates integrated with social sharing/network components
* Create reusable snippets for standardized footers and modular content blocks across landing pages and emails


**Integrations \& Tech Stack**
* Integrate and manage third\-party platforms within Marketo, including webinar/virtual event tools (Zoom, ON24\), event registration platforms (Aventri, Certain), and mobile push notification channels
* Work with CRM platforms such as Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics, ensuring seamless lead/contact flow, field mapping, and sync configuration between Marketo and the CRM
* Troubleshoot CRM–Marketo sync issues (e.g., sync errors, field mismatches, duplicate records, blocked syncs) and implement fixes to maintain reliable, real\-time data flow \- Apply data enrichment practices — using enrichment tools, form\-based progressive profiling, and third\-party data append — to keep lead and contact records complete and up to date
* Demonstrate strong API familiarity, including configuring and managing API user roles/permissions, working with REST APIs for platform integrations, and troubleshooting API\- based data exchanges
* Test new services, integrations, and platform updates prior to launch


**Lead Lifecycle: Nurturing, Scoring \& Personalization**
* Build and maintain lead nurturing and lead scoring programs at both the global/instance level and individual campaign level
* Design and execute web personalization campaigns using dynamic content, web campaigns, and audience segments
* Develop lifecycle models and continuously refine scoring frameworks to improve lead quality and MQL conversion


**Data Management \& Segmentation**
* Define and maintain audience segmentation strategies at both the client/account level and individual project level
* Own database hygiene, list imports, and data quality processes to maintain a clean, actionable database
* Support governance and documentation standards for data usage across programs


**Events \& Content Programs**
* Manage end\-to\-end program setup for trade shows, including personalized agendas and dynamic imagery per attendee/segment
* Build and manage webinar, online event, and gated content programs, including registration, reminder, and follow\-up flows
* Own program status tracking and post\-event hygiene (e.g., processing attendee/lead downloads, deduplication, list cleanup)


**Enablement, Governance \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as subject\-matter expert (SME) for the marketing automation platform, supporting troubleshooting, consultations, and new project readiness
* Provide training and documentation to internal teams, marketing ops representatives, and business stakeholders
* Partner with stakeholders to define requirements, governance standards, and rollout plans for new pilots or workspaces
* Support onboarding of new projects/workspaces onto the platform, including QA and functionality testing


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 4–7 years of hands\-on experience managing a marketing automation platform (Marketo strongly preferred; Eloqua, Pardot, or HubSpot experience also considered)
* Marketo Certified Expert certification preferred (or willingness to obtain)
* Proven experience building advanced Smart Campaigns, Programs, and multi\-step nurture/lead scoring logic
* Experience integrating Marketo with third\-party tools (webinar platforms, event management tools, CRM, mobile/push notification systems)
* Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), including lead/contact sync configuration and troubleshooting CRM–Marketo data flow issues
* Familiarity with data enrichment tools and practices to maintain accurate and complete records
* Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive/media\-query email template design
* Experience with progressive profiling, dynamic/personalized content, and web segmentation
* Solid understanding of database segmentation, list hygiene, and data governance best practices
* Experience managing event marketing programs (webinars, trade shows, gated content) end\-to\-end
* Familiarity with Git or a similar version control tool (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) for tracking changes to custom scripts, JavaScript used in forms/landing pages, and code\-based assets
* Nice to have:
* Experience with Zoom, ON24, Aventri, or Certain integrations
* Experience supporting global, multi\-region marketing operations
* Exposure to lifecycle model design and cross\-functional campaign governance
* A/B testing and campaign performance reporting experience
* Exposure to CI/CD deployment practices for managing and releasing code\-based assets (custom scripts, templates,
* integrations) in a structured, version\-controlled way


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You will work within a Global Digital Marketing Automation and Email platform team across multiple geographies, collaborating with business stakeholders, architects, and platform teams. This role offers the opportunity to directly shape internal tools used globally across BCG.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**You're Good At**
* Working with APIs — understanding of REST API concepts, managing API user roles/permissions, and supporting API\-driven integrations
* Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive/media\-query email template design
* Strong communication skills with experience training stakeholders and documenting processes
* Detail\-oriented, process\-driven, and comfortable owning platform QA/testing before launches


*"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."*
 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Frontend Intern
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building more than just AI tools; we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post\-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world. From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
   

  

 We’re a fast\-growing, passionate team backed over 100K\+ active users globally.
   

  

 But we’re just getting started. Our mission is clear: solve the biggest pain points in photography, and keep evolving with photographers who use our tools daily.
   

  

 If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
   

  

 🚀
 **About the Role**
 We are looking for enthusiastic Frontend Interns to join our engineering team. You'll work alongside product engineers and designers to build and ship user\-facing features across our desktop and web applications, while learning how a production frontend codebase is really built and maintained.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Translate designs and product requirements into clean, responsive UI components.
* Build and ship features for our desktop and web applications under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Fix bugs and improve the performance and responsiveness of existing screens.
* Write reusable components and contribute to our shared component library.
* Participate in code reviews and act on feedback.
* Collaborate with design, QA, and backend engineers to take features from ticket to release.
* Learn and adopt frontend best practices, coding standards, and Git workflows.


**Required Skills**
* Solid fundamentals in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Working knowledge of React (components, props, state, hooks).
* Basic understanding of TypeScript.
* Familiarity with browser developer tools and debugging in the browser.
* Understanding of responsive layouts and cross\-browser behavior.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail, especially in matching UI to design.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Eagerness to learn and take ownership of what you ship.


**Preferred Skills (Good To Have)**
* Understanding of REST APIs and consuming them from the frontend.
* Experience with Tailwind CSS or a similar utility\-first framework.
* Familiarity with state management (Redux, Zustand, or Context API).


**Eligibility**
* BE/B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc (Computer Science/IT).
* Freshers or final\-year students are encouraged to apply.


**What You'll Learn**
* End\-to\-end QA automation for web and desktop applications.
* Writing maintainable automation scripts using modern frameworks.
* Test planning, execution, and defect lifecycle management.
* CI/CD integration for automated testing.
* Working in an Agile software development environment.
* Industry best practices for software quality assurance.


**You will work with**
* Captain: Himanshu
* Team Members: Lavi and the rest of the Aftershoot team.
