description:
**Applied AI Internship Programme** 




 The Applied AI Internship Programme at RSAI Academy offers a practical, hands\-on opportunity to work on real\-world AI learning initiatives, technical prototypes, content design, and operational workflows. This grouped programme brings together diverse skill sets to build, test, and support educational experiences that help learners understand and apply artificial intelligence responsibly. This intake brings together seven workstreams.
 



  





**About the programme** 




 This internship provides a structured environment where participants focus on concrete, reviewable projects across technical development, user research, instructional design, and operational support. Interns collaborate with team members to translate complex AI concepts into accessible learning tools, test platform features for quality and accessibility, and maintain clear documentation that supports ongoing educational initiatives.
 



  





 Throughout the programme, participants apply systematic thinking to real challenges, ensuring that all learning assets, code prototypes, and operational workflows meet high standards of clarity and responsible AI practice. By focusing on observable outcomes and evidence\-based decisions, interns gain direct experience in how modern educational platforms design, build, and scale their learning experiences.
 



  





**Available workstreams** 




 This intake includes seven workstreams.
 



 • AI Product \& Research Intern: Research learner problems and applied AI workflows, turn evidence into clear findings, and help frame practical product experiments and decisions.
 



 • AI Developer \& Learning Projects Intern: Build scoped AI learning prototypes and technical exercises, test their important paths, and prepare clear setup and maintenance handoffs.
 



 • Content \& Learning Design Intern: Shape practical AI lessons, examples, exercises, and guidance so learners can understand concepts and apply them with confidence.
 



 • Growth, Social \& Community Intern: Support campaign and publishing workflows, research audience opportunities, prepare useful distribution assets, and close the loop on performance and community feedback.
 



 • Learner Operations \& Admissions Support Intern: Coordinate learner and admissions support with empathy, maintain accurate follow\-up records, and turn recurring operational friction into practical improvements.
 



 • QA \& Platform Testing Intern: Test learner and operator flows, investigate meaningful edge cases, and produce reproducible issue reports and release\-verification evidence.
 



 • Design \& UX Intern: Review learner and operator journeys, prepare focused wireframes and interaction notes, and improve usability, accessibility, and visual consistency.
 



  





**What interns may work on** 




 • Researching learner needs, evaluating applied AI workflows, and framing structured product experiments.
 



 • Building and testing scoped technical prototypes, learning exercises, and workflow utilities.
 



 • Drafting and refining instructional content, lesson outlines, and practical learning guides.
 



 • Coordinating learner support operations, tracking admissions inquiries, and resolving platform issues.
 



 • Conducting exploratory and regression testing across platform features to identify and document bugs.
 



 • Mapping user journeys, creating wireframes, and designing accessible interface improvements.
 



  





**What interns will deliver** 




 • A structured research brief detailing learner problems, evidence reviewed, and open questions.
 



 • A working technical prototype or guided coding exercise with setup notes and test evidence.
 



 • A reviewed lesson outline, learning asset, or facilitator\-ready content brief.
 



 • A campaign brief or content calendar detailing target audiences, messaging, and publishing schedules.
 



 • A learner\-support tracker or operating checklist with assigned owners and follow\-up states.
 



 • A reproducible issue report detailing steps, evidence, and expected versus actual behavior.
 



  





**What helps candidates succeed** 




 • Ability to separate observations, assumptions, and conclusions in written documentation.
 



 • Foundation in analytical research, programming, design, or instructional writing demonstrated through prior projects.
 



 • Commitment to testing edge cases, protecting user privacy, and practicing responsible AI development.
 



 • Openness to structured editorial feedback, usability evidence, and iterative improvement.
 



 • Strong written communication skills with an emphasis on clarity, accuracy, and empathy.
 



  





**Core programme skills** 




 • Product research and synthesis
 



 • Programming and API integration
 



 • Instructional writing and learning design
 



 • Exploratory and regression testing
 



 • Journey mapping and wireframing
 



 • Operations coordination and support
 



 • Responsible AI guidance and practice
 



  





**Working arrangement** 




 This is an unpaid, time\-bound internship with a defined scope, review rhythm, and completion criteria. No stipend or salary is provided.
 



 • Remote
 



 • India
 



 • 30\-40 hours per week
 



 • 6 months
 



  





**Selection process** 




 • RSAI Academy reviews the application for relevant evidence, learning intent, availability, communication, and fit with the current scope.
 



 • Shortlisted applicants may complete a focused conversation or practical task before a final decision.
 



  





**Important expectations** 




 • We value clear communication, respectful collaboration, learner safety, confidentiality, and responsible AI practice. Selected contributors are expected to follow the agreed scope and RSAI Academy policies.
 



  





**About RSAI Academy** 




 RSAI Academy is the practical AI learning brand of Rhythmic Souls Private Limited. We help learners and working professionals build useful AI skills through live instruction, guided practice, mentorship, and real\-world projects.
 



  





 Our programmes focus on clarity, responsible AI use, measurable outcomes, and skills that can be applied in real work.
 



  





**How to apply** 




 Apply through the RSAI Academy website using the application link in this posting. This helps us review every application in the correct role context. We do not accept applications through platform\-native forms, email, or direct messages.
 



  





 Application information is used only to evaluate and manage the relevant RSAI Academy opportunity, subject to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

title: Applied AI Sr Associate Engineer
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
   

  

 If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
   

  

 Skills and Competencies
   

  

* 3–5 years of hands\-on full\-stack engineering experience with a track record of independently delivering production\-quality applications end to end; proficiency in React 18 with TypeScript (component architecture, hooks, state management with Zustand or Redux, and React Router for complex multi\-view portals), Node.js/Express for BFF APIs (including authentication flows, request proxying, caching, and structured error handling), and Python/FastAPI for backend microservices and data processing pipelines.
* Solid understanding of SQL, PostgreSQL (schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and workflow state persistence) and Redis (caching, session management, and task queue brokering via Celery or equivalent); proficiency with Docker for containerizing Node.js and Python services with identical dev/prod environments; ability to build and maintain GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines covering lint, unit test, build, and zero\-downtime deploy on merge.
* Experience integrating with Salesforce REST APIs and SOQL — reading Cases, Accounts, Contacts, Tasks, and Activity History at volume — is preferred; familiarity with Salesforce Connected App setup, OAuth 2\.0 flows, and per\-user token management; experience triggering write\-backs via Flows or Apex REST endpoints with validation gates and audit logging; exposure to Salesforce Platform Events or Pub/Sub API for real\-time case state change handling is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on experience integrating LLM models into production applications — prompt engineering, context management, structured output parsing, and cost control; familiarity with LangChain (Python) or equivalent orchestration frameworks for chaining LLM calls, managing memory, and enforcing guardrails; understanding of embedding\-based semantic search (text\-embedding\-ada\-002 or similar) for similarity scoring and duplicate detection; commitment to human\-in\-the\-loop design — AI assists and drafts; humans review and commit — enforced at the API layer, not just the UI.
* Proficiency with Pandas and openpyxl for Excel\-in/Excel\-out data processing pipelines; experience with fuzzy matching libraries (RapidFuzz or similar) for entity deduplication and overlap analysis; exposure to graph traversal (NetworkX or equivalent) for ownership hierarchy and relation analysis; ability to integrate with external data APIs.
* Strong grasp of REST API design principles including versioning, error contracts, pagination, and backward compatibility; ability to write well\-structured, tested code — unit tests, integration tests, and API contract tests as part of the development workflow, not an afterthought; experience maintaining an append\-only audit log tied to business entity IDs for compliance and traceability; comfortable self\-managing across frontend, backend, AI, and infrastructure layers in a high\-autonomy environment within a 2\-week sprint cadence.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.


**Responsibilities**
* Build an end\-to\-end AI\-assisted operations platform that replaces manual Salesforce workflows and spreadsheet\-based processes with an auditable, intelligent console. Implement the full AI\-driven platform architecture across multiple production phases; build the React 18 \+ TypeScript portal spanning all stakeholder views; engineer the FastAPI Python workflow service with async Excel\-in/Excel\-out processing, Celery task queuing, and status polling.
* Provision and maintain the Salesforce Connected App; manage the OAuth token lifecycle; implement read operations across Cases, Accounts, Contacts, Tasks, and Activity History; build validated Salesforce write\-back flows (merge, email update, segment patch) with AI pre\-flight checks and analyst confirmation gates before any SFDC commit; implement real\-time case state monitoring via Salesforce Platform Events to drive escalation detection.
* Integrate case summarization, duplicate analysis, action pre\-flight checks, and an AI chat assistant pre\-seeded with live case context; implement the escalation prediction engine; enforce human\-in\-the\-loop guardrails at the API layer.
* Manage phased delivery with defined go\-live milestones; lead UAT sessions with analysts, managers, and leadership at each phase go\-live, and incorporate feedback into the subsequent sprint backlog; maintain Azure infrastructure, monitor application health, and own incident response throughout the build period.
* Document architecture decisions, API contracts, data schemas, and operational runbooks to support long\-term maintainability beyond the build phase.


**About The Team**
 Our Data Management \& Analytics team within COR OU is responsible for maintaining Account and Contact information with CRM, we are currently looking at transformation towards AI\-assisted operations platform that converts manual Salesforce workflows, spreadsheet\-based verification, and ad\-hoc bulk data processes into a structured, auditable, and intelligent console.
   

  

 Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.
